message.content:
Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a clear and significant deviation from the baseline trend starting around index 600. The data fluctuates roughly between 0 and -5 for the first 600 points, but then drops sharply to values between -10 and -25. This constitutes an anomaly range.

The anomalous behavior begins approximately at x = 600 and continues until the end of the plotted data (around x = 730).

[[600, 730]]
